en.headline: Fujian chef Levi You opens Hokkien House in Central
en.dek: The Zhangzhou-born chef-patron, winner of the inaugural Michelin Guide Fujian Young Chef Award, began service on Friday at H Queen's on Queen's Road Central.

zh.headline: 福建年輕廚師游振龍中環開「福上」
zh.dek: 漳州出生的主廚兼東主上周五在皇后大道中H Queen's二十一樓開業，他是首屆《米芝蓮指南．福建》年輕廚師獎得主。

en.headline: Sha Tin opens the 2026/27 racing season this afternoon
en.dek: The Jockey Club starts the new season at Sha Tin from 11.15am, with the first of 10 races at 12.30pm; Horse of the Year Ka Ying Rising runs in the Chief Executive's Cup.

zh.headline: 2026/27馬季今日沙田開鑼 嘉應高昇出戰特首盃
zh.dek: 沙田馬場上午十一時十五分展開開鑼活動，首場下午十二時三十分開跑，共十場；上季馬王嘉應高昇出戰第三場香港特區行政長官盃。

en.headline: Motorcyclist left unconscious after crash at Aberdeen Tunnel exit
en.dek: A man aged about 30 was taken to Queen Mary Hospital after his scooter hit a crash barrier near the tunnel bus interchange early on Sunday; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 香港仔隧道出口綿羊仔撞欄 約30歲鐵騎士昏迷送院
zh.dek: 今晨約兩時三十五分，一輛綿羊仔駞出香港仔隧道後撞向風琴式防撞欄，鐵騎士昏迷送瑪麗醫院，警方調查原因。

en.headline: The Gruffalo plays two more shows at APA today
en.dek: Tall Stories' hour-long English musical of the Julia Donaldson picture book continues at the Wan Chai campus this afternoon, with a second weekend next week.

zh.headline: 《咕噜牛》今日在演藝學院尚有兩場
zh.dek: 根據朱莉娅唐納森繪本改編的英語音樂劇今早十一時及下午二時在灣仔演藝學院上演，下周末十一至十三日還有第二輪場次。

en.headline: Hong Kong youth squash team to make world championships debut
en.dek: Nineteen players will leave for New York next week after a send-off attended by Financial Secretary Paul Chan, the first time the city fields a youth squash side at the worlds.

zh.headline: 港青年牆球隊下周首征紐約世錦賽
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波昨日出席誓師大會，約三十名隊員之中十九人將啟程出賽，是香港首次派出青年牆球代表隊出戰世錦賽。

en.headline: Lee Cheuk Yiu and Ng Wing Lun meet in China Masters final
en.dek: The two Hong Kong shuttlers will contest the Super 750 men's singles title in Shenzhen this afternoon after both upset higher-ranked opponents on Saturday.

zh.headline: 李卓耀吳英倫會師中國大師賽男單決賽
zh.dek: 兩名港將周六先後爆冷擊敗更高排名對手，今日下午在深圳爭奪超級750男單冠軍，亦是港隊首次包辦此級別單打決賽席位。

en.headline: Kau Kee opens first retail shop after 66 years supplying fish balls to eateries
en.dek: The Mong Kok factory that has long supplied nearly 1,000 local stalls and restaurants now sells its signature fish balls and snacks directly to the public.

zh.headline: 九記魚蛋廠66年後開首間零售店 直接售予市民
zh.dek: 長年供應近千間食肆及小食檔的旺角魚蛋廠，去年底開設首間零售店，市民可直接購買招牌魚蛋及小食。

en.headline: Police arrest taxi driver for demanding five times the fare to The Peak
en.dek: Undercover officers were quoted HK$350 for a short Central-to-Peak ride that should cost about HK$66; the 69-year-old faces four charges including overcharging.

zh.headline: 警放蛇拘索五倍車資的士司機 中環往山頂收350元
zh.dek: 喬裝乘客由山頂纜車中環總站往山頂，合理車資約66元，司機索價350元；69歲男子涉四罪被捕。

en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival ends today at Victoria Park
en.dek: The three-day event marking the Hungry Ghost Festival closes Sunday with competitions, workshops, an immersive theatre piece and Chiu Chow food stalls; admission is free.

zh.headline: 盂蘭文化節今日維園煞科 搶孤及互動劇場繼續
zh.dek: 一連三日的盂蘭文化節今日於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號球場舉行最後一天，設搶孤競賽、工作坊、實境劇場及潮汕美食攤位，免費入場。

en.headline: Tesla driver dies after collision on Island Eastern Corridor
en.dek: 54-year-old man found unconscious with no superficial injuries; police investigating possible medical episode while driving.

zh.headline: 東區走廊Tesla司機撞車後不治 警查是否駕駛時不適
zh.dek: 54歲男子昏迷送院，無表面傷痕；初步不排除暈倒後車輛失控。

en.headline: Government to hold Tiangong Classroom with Hong Kong astronaut soon
en.dek: Shenzhou-23 crew including first Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying will give science demonstrations and hold a live dialogue with Hong Kong and Macao students.

zh.headline: 政府近日舉辦天宮課堂 黎家盈等與港澳學生天地對話
zh.dek: 神舟二十三號乘組包括首位港產載荷專家黎家盈將在空間站進行科學實驗示範，並與港澳學生實時交流。

en.headline: CHP records new mpox case; 26-year-old man in stable condition
en.dek: Patient had two high-risk contacts with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period; total cases since 2022 reach 100, all male.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗猴痘確診 26歲男情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者潛伏期內在港以外與一名男子有兩次高風險接觸；自2022年起累計100宗個案，全部為男性。

en.headline: Housing Society posts HK$1.338 billion surplus for third consecutive year
en.dek: Net assets reached HK$49.9 billion at end-March; more than 15,000 units expected to be completed over the next five financial years.

zh.headline: 房協二零二五至二六年度盈餘十三點三八億 連續三年錄得盈餘
zh.dek: 截至三月底淨資產四百九十九億元，未來五個財政年度預計落成逾一萬五千個單位。

en.headline: Fourteen fall ill after buffet at Eaton HK restaurant; premises closed for cleaning
en.dek: CHP links five clusters to The Astor at Eaton Hong Kong in Yau Ma Tei; all affected diners are stable and none required hospital admission.

zh.headline: 逸東酒店The Astor食物中毒群組增至十四人 食肆暫時停業
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指五個群組有流行病學關連，受影響人士情況穩定，無人需入院。

en.headline: Three arrested, 1,600 unregistered vials seized in vaccine-related raids
en.dek: Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau said none of the seized items were the touted WT1 cancer-prevention product; no reports of anyone receiving the injection locally.

zh.headline: 無牌針劑搜查拘三人 檢獲一千六百劑未經註冊製品
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示檢獲物品並非聲稱的WT1防癌疫苗，暫無發現有人在港注射。

en.headline: CHP records three more severe paediatric flu cases; one girl critical
en.dek: A six-year-old girl is in critical condition with influenza A complicated by encephalopathy; a three-year-old girl and 15-year-old boy are in serious condition.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心再錄三宗兒童流感嚴重個案 一女童危殆
zh.dek: 六歲女童甲型流感併發腦病變情況危殆，三歲女童及十五歲男童情況嚴重，三人過往均健康良好。

en.headline: Lee names finance, technology and education as key growth drivers ahead of five-year plan
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan would set broad strategies aligning with the national 15th five-year plan, while the Policy Address would focus on concrete measures.

zh.headline: 李家超：金融、創科、教育為五年規劃三大新增長動力
zh.dek: 行政長官在社交平台表示，首份五年規劃將訂立宏觀策略並對接國家「十五五」，施政報告則聚焦具體措施，兩者一脈相承。

en.headline: Overhead display left dangling at airport Terminal 2 after cable fault
en.dek: A suspended electronic screen at the newly reopened Terminal 2 dropped several metres on Saturday morning but was caught by its fall-arrest system; no one was hurt.

zh.headline: 機場T2離港大堂顯示屏鋼纜故障半天吊 無人受傷
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，二號客運大樓離港層一塊懸掛電子顯示屏出現故障，防墮系統即時發揮作用，無人受傷，機管局將深入調查。

en.headline: Choi says new school year is running smoothly as enrolment decline persists
en.dek: The education chief said falling school-age population is a structural problem that must be faced, and that measures used to keep school numbers have been exhausted.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮：新學年運作暢順 學齡人口下降須面對
zh.dek: 教育局局長指出生率下跌屬結構問題，保存學校數目的措施已用盡，期望辦學團體及早規劃合併或停辦。

en.headline: Help unit for residents abroad logs over 3,000 cases in eight months
en.dek: The Immigration Department said requests rose about 35 per cent from a year earlier, driven mainly by the Middle East conflict early this year; about half of the remaining cases involved lost travel documents.

zh.headline: 協助在外港人小組首8個月接逾3000宗求助
zh.dek: 入境處處長郭俊峯表示數字較去年同期升約三成半，主要與年初中東衝突有關；其餘個案約一半涉及遺失旅行證件。

en.headline: Huanggang port to open as soon as Hong Kong and Shenzhen confirm smooth operations
en.dek: Immigration chief Benson Kwok said no date is fixed yet, but both sides want to open the rebuilt checkpoint as soon as operations are confirmed smooth, including before National Day if conditions allow.

zh.headline: 郭俊峯：皇崗口岸待港深確認暢順後盡早開通
zh.dek: 入境處處長表示未敲定開通日期，但若運作暢順會盡早啟用，不排除趕及國慶黃金周前；初期料每日可處理約20萬人次。

en.headline: Film Archive opens ticket sales for Cheng Pei-pei matinee series
en.dek: Ten films spanning romance, wuxia, kung fu and comedy screen at Sai Wan Ho from 2 October to 4 December; tickets are $40 from today on URBTIX.

zh.headline: 電影資料館鄭佩佩回顧今起售票 十部作品10月起映
zh.dek: 「俠影翩躊──懷念鄭佩佩」由10月2日至12月4日在西灣河資料館放映，門票40元，今日起於城市售票網發售。

en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail booking trial starts this weekend
en.dek: Visitors heading to the High Island Geo-Trail section at Sai Kung East Dam between 9am and 5pm today and Sunday need a free, named reservation under a 2,000-person daily cap.

zh.headline: 破邊洲段預約制今起試行 每日名額二千
zh.dek: 西貢萬宜東壩地質步道破邊洲段今明兩日上午九時至下午五時須免費實名預約，每兩小時一段、每日合共二千人。

en.headline: Government opens three-month consultation on food sweetener rules
en.dek: Proposed changes would bring sugar alcohols under the law, expand the permitted list from 10 to 21 additives and set maximum levels for specific food pairings.

zh.headline: 政府就食物甜味劑規例展開三個月公眾諮詢
zh.dek: 建議將多美醇納入規管、准用名單由10種增至21種，並按食物與甜味劑組合訂最高含量，完成立法後擬設18個月過渡期。

en.headline: Cavalluna horses settle in at Kai Tak ahead of Tuesday opening
en.dek: Fifty-four European horses arrived this week for eight performances of the equestrian theatre show at Kai Tak Arena from 8 to 13 September.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場名駒抵港 啟德體藝館週二首演
zh.dek: 54匹歐洲馬匹本周運抵啟德體育園，《CAVALLUNA 穿梭異境》將於9月8日至13日上演八場。

en.headline: Development Bureau orders review of Queen Mary Hospital lift works
en.dek: ArchSD and EMSD must report on how they accepted and supervised the new Clinical Block lifts; follow-up repairs are due by the end of the year.

zh.headline: 發展局要求兩署檢視瑪麗醫院新大樓升降機監管
zh.dek: 建築署及機電署須就驗收及監管工作提交報告；善後工程料於今年第四季完成。

en.headline: Hong Kong signs 60th tax pact, this time with Slovenia
en.dek: The comprehensive double-tax agreement is the fifth concluded this year; it still needs ratification before the new withholding rates take effect.

zh.headline: 香港與斯洛文尼亞簽署第60份全面性稅務協定
zh.dek: 這是本屆政府第15份、今年第五份全面性避免雙重課稅協定，須待雙方完成批准程序後生效。

en.headline: Rumsey Street car park floors to close for Interpol assembly
en.dek: Police will take over the seventh and eighth floors of the Sheung Wan public car park from 1 November as a traffic command centre for the 94th Interpol General Assembly.

zh.headline: 林士街停車場兩層將關閉 供國際刑警大會調度車輛
zh.dek: 警方將於11月1日起徵用上環林士街多層停車場7樓及8樓作交通指揮中心，大會後12月12日重開。

en.headline: Kennedy Town sea wall proposed for Grade 2 historic status
en.dek: The century-old New Praya structure, a popular waterfront selfie spot, has been recommended for listing after an assessment by the Historic Buildings Assessment Panel.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城新海旁海堤擬列二級歷史建築
zh.dek: 古物古蹟辦事處歷史建築評估小組建議將這道逾百年海堤評為二級，供公眾諮詢一個月。

en.headline: Police arrest 269 in tech-scam crackdown; phone-scam losses hit HK$900m in H1
en.dek: A two-week operation netted 269 people linked to 203 cases with HK$320 million in losses; overall deception cases fell slightly but phone and phishing fraud rose sharply.

zh.headline: 警方兩周拘269人打科技騙案 上半年電話騙案損失9億
zh.dek: 行動涉及203宗案件、損失約3.2億元；整體詐騙案微跌，但電話及釣魚騙案分別升45%及61%。

en.headline: Dairy Queen to open four Hong Kong stores from November
en.dek: The American ice-cream chain plans a Causeway Bay flagship at One Causeway Bay, followed by outlets in Kwun Tong, the New Territories and outlying islands, marking its return after a brief 1979 presence.

zh.headline: Dairy Queen 11月起連開四店重返香港
zh.dek: 美國雪糕品牌首店落戶銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay，觀塘The Angle亦已圍板，另兩店將覆蓋新界及離島，相隔近半世紀後再臨。

en.headline: HK Marathon 2027 sets record 78,000 main-race quota
en.dek: Half-marathon places rise by 4,000 to 29,000; new 5 km harbourfront run and expanded youth event bring total two-day participation to 84,000.

zh.headline: 2027渣馬主賽事名額破紀錄達78,000
zh.dek: 半馬名額增4,000至29,000；新增5公里海濱跑及擴大少年跑，兩日總參與人數料達84,000。

en.headline: Five plead guilty to $3.2m ParknShop warehouse ‘ghost worker’ fraud
en.dek: ICAC says former supermarket and contractor staff used a duplicate clocking machine to falsify attendance for 13 non-existent workers over two years; sentencing adjourned to March 2027.

zh.headline: 百佳「鬼工」詐騙案五人認罪 涉款逾320萬
zh.dek: 廉署指前超市及承辦商職員用相同打卡機偽造13名從未上班工人的出勤紀錄，騙取工資逾320萬元；案件押後至明年3月判刑。

en.headline: HKMA flags about 400 cases of unauthorised contactless payment-card binding
en.dek: Fraudsters use phishing messages, fake sites or calls to obtain card details and PINs, then coax victims into approving binding requests so they can make unauthorised transactions.

zh.headline: 金管局：近期約400宗支付卡被綁定非接觸式流動支付騙案
zh.dek: 騙徒以釣魚訊息、假網站或電話誘騙取得卡資料及密碼，再誘使受害人批准綁定以便進行未經授權交易。

en.headline: Council finds intentional unlawful conduct may have caused Heal Fertility embryo mix-up
en.dek: No embryos were mixed or wrongly implanted; the clinic lacked sufficient protective measures and failed to report the serious event on time, the regulator said.

zh.headline: 希愈胚胎樣本錯配 管理局指或涉個人蓄意不法行為
zh.dek: 確認無胚胎混淆或錯誤植入；中心防護措施不足且未按時呈報，管理局已要求改善並繼續支援警方調查。

en.headline: Four arrested over alleged drug deliveries to Princess Margaret Hospital wards
en.dek: Police say two men delivered narcotics to inpatients after staff found two female patients with suspected dangerous drugs; about HK$20,000 worth of ketamine, heroin and cocaine seized.

zh.headline: 瑪嘉烈醫院病房涉運毒 警拘四男女
zh.dek: 院方發現兩名女病人藏有懷疑危險藥物，警方揭有人運送毒品入病房，檢獲市值約2萬元氯胺酮、海洛英及可卡因。

en.headline: MTR completes first phase of Tung Chung Line track diversion
en.dek: From 13 September, trains leaving Tung Chung for Hong Kong will run on the new section linking to the future Tung Chung East station; journey times and frequencies remain unchanged.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌綫延線路軌改道首階段完成
zh.dek: 9月13日起由東涌開出往香港方向列車將改行新路段，接駁未來東涌東站；行車時間及班次維持不變。

en.headline: CHP records severe paediatric influenza A case; girl in serious condition
en.dek: A 14-year-old girl with underlying illnesses developed severe pneumonia and septic shock; the centre urges early vaccination when the seasonal programme begins on 17 September.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心錄得一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感個案
zh.dek: 一名14歲有長期病患的女童出現嚴重肺炎及敗血性休克；中心呼籲9月17日季節性流感疫苗接種計劃展開後盡早接種。

en.headline: CFS urges public not to eat three French cheese batches over Listeria risk
en.dek: Three batches of Brie-style cheese from the Paturages Comtois brand are under recall after a European alert; importers have stopped sales and begun recalls.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食用三批次法國芝士 疑受李斯特菌污染
zh.dek: 三款Paturages Comtois品牌布里芝士因歐盟警報被回收，入口商已停售並展開回收。

en.headline: Silver Bonds draw record 478,000 applications worth nearly HK$120 billion
en.dek: The latest three-year issue with a 4.25 per cent guaranteed floor attracted strong demand from eligible residents aged 60 and above; final issuance is expected to reach the HK$55 billion ceiling.

zh.headline: 銀債認購創紀錄 47.8萬人申請近1200億元
zh.dek: 最新一批三年期銀債保底息4.25厘，合資格60歲或以上市民反應踴躍；預計最終發行額將達上限550億元。

en.headline: Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel to close from 12 October for major renovation
en.dek: The Victorian-style hotel, open since 2005, will undergo comprehensive upgrades including more Disney movie-themed rooms; the other two resort hotels remain open.

zh.headline: 香港迪士尼樂園酒店10月12日起暫時關閉翻新
zh.dek: 開業以來的維多利亞式酒店將進行全面升級，增加迪士尼電影主題房間；另外兩間度假酒店維持開放。

en.headline: CityU says students in orientation-camp incident admitted fault; discipline imposed
en.dek: City University of Hong Kong said students involved in an orientation-camp incident have admitted their mistakes and that its disciplinary committee has imposed penalties; the organising society has been dissolved.

zh.headline: 城大：迎新營涉事學生已承認過失 紀律委員會已作出處分
zh.dek: 城大表示，涉及迎新營事件的學生已承認過失，紀律委員會已作出紀律處分；主辦幹事會已被學生會解散。

en.headline: Fire at IVE Tsing Yi campus store room; 400 evacuate, none hurt
en.dek: A store room on the ground floor of the Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education’s Tsing Yi campus caught fire on Friday morning; firefighters extinguished it quickly and about 400 staff and students left the…

zh.headline: 青衣IVE雜物房起火 約400師生自行疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 香港專業教育學院青衣分校今早地下雜物房起火，消防迅速救熄，約400名師生自行疏散，無人受傷，起火原因相信無可疑。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific cancels Dubai and Riyadh flights until end of November
en.dek: The carrier said passenger services to the two Middle East destinations remain suspended through 30 November 2026 because of the latest regional developments, with free rebooking, rerouting or refunds offered to…

zh.headline: 國泰取消往返迪拜及利雅得航班至11月底
zh.dek: 國泰航空表示，因應中東最新事態發展，往返迪拜及利雅得的客運航班將取消至2026年11月30日，受影響旅客可免費改期、改道或退款。

en.headline: National Ecology Day exhibition runs through Sunday in Kwun Tong
en.dek: The Countryside Conservation Office’s free show at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, combining Mirs Bay photography, village stories and live countryside music, is scheduled to close on 6 September.

zh.headline: 全國生態日專題展觀塘續開至周日
zh.dek: 鄉郊保育辦事處在東九文化中心「隅」舉辦的免費展覽結合印洲塘影像、鄉村故事及鄉郊音樂，展期至九月六日。

en.headline: Ex-lawmaker Wong Kam-fai faces four driving charges next week
en.dek: Police have charged former legislator Wong Kam-fai with drink-driving and related offences over a June collision at the CUHK campus; he appears at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on 9 September.

zh.headline: 前議員黃錦輝被控酒駕等四罪 下周三提堂
zh.dek: 警方已就六月中大校園交通意外向立法會前議員黃錦輝落案起訴酒後駕駛等四項控罪，案件下周三在沙田裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Weekend outlook: cloudy with showers after Saudel fades
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects mainly cloudy skies with isolated showers and sunny intervals on Saturday and Sunday, with highs around 31 degrees after tropical cyclone signals were cancelled overnight.

zh.headline: 周末展望：沙德爾消散後多雲有驟雨
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六及周日大致多雲，有一兩陣驟雨，日間間中有陽光，最高氣溫約31度；本港已於凌晨取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號。

en.headline: Luxury Festival of Connoisseurs slated for November debut
en.dek: Informa Markets and the Hong Kong Tourism Board plan the first Festival of Connoisseurs this November, with a larger edition scheduled for 2027.

zh.headline: 鑑賞家盛典擬11月首辦
zh.dek: Informa Markets與旅發局計劃今年11月在港首辦「鑑賞家盛典」，2027年再擴大規模。

en.headline: Chiikawa Artiverse at K11 Musea runs through Sunday
en.dek: The character exhibition at K11 Musea and the Tsim Sha Tsui harbourfront, including an outdoor carousel installation, is scheduled to end on 6 September.

zh.headline: 吉伊卡哇藝術宇宙特展周日完結
zh.dek: K11 Musea及尖沙咀海濰的吉伊卡哇特展連戶外迴旋木馬裝置，據場地及旅發局資料將於9月6日結束。

en.headline: ITC backs three smart-factory projects under acceleration scheme
en.dek: The Innovation and Technology Commission said a vetting committee had supported in principle three applications covering health products, semiconductor memory and construction prefabrication.

zh.headline: 創科署原則支持三宗新型工業加速計劃申請
zh.dek: 創新科技署表示，評審委員會原則上支持三宗申請，涵蓋保健品、半導體記憶體及建造預製加工設施。

en.headline: CENTRESTAGE runs through Saturday at the convention centre
en.dek: The 11th edition of the HKTDC fashion fair is open free to adults who pre-register, with about 270 brands from 24 countries and regions on show until 5 September.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展今明兩日繼續 週六閉幕
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的第11屆CENTRESTAGE於會展舉行至9月5日，約370個來自24個國家及地區品牌參展，18歲或以上事先登記可免費入場。

en.headline: 37th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival opens today
en.dek: Asia’s longest-running LGBTQ+ film festival runs until 20 September with 37 features and 38 shorts, grouped by mood rather than genre, at three Broadway Circuit cinemas.

zh.headline: 第37屆香港同志影展今日開幕 放映至20日
zh.dek: 亞洲歷史最惠久的LGBTQ+影展今年帶來37部長片及38部短片，按心情分類，在百老匯三間戲院放映至9月20日。

en.headline: SFC tightens disclosure for funds holding private-market assets
en.dek: A circular dated 3 September requires authorised funds with private credit or private equity exposure to spell out how much they hold, how they hold it, and the risks, and may treat heavy exposure as a complex product.

zh.headline: 證監會要求認可基金加強私募市場投資披露
zh.dek: 證監會周四發出通函，要求投資私募信貸或私募股權的認可基金說明暴露程度、途徑及風險；私募市場資產達淨值五成或以上可被視為複雜產品。

en.headline: Star Voyager cancels remaining 2026 Hong Kong sailings
en.dek: Star Cruises has dropped 17 autumn departures from Ocean Terminal after a change in regional deployment, and has scheduled the ship on Southeast Asian routes from Singapore and Malaysia instead.

zh.headline: 領航星號取消今年剩下香港航次 調往東南亞
zh.dek: 麗星郵輪因區域部署變動，取消領航星號原定9月30日至11月15日由尖沙嘴海運碼頭出發的17個航次，改由新加坡及馬來西亞出發。

en.headline: Silence Wang opens three-night Kai Tak Stadium residency tonight
en.dek: Mainland singer-songwriter Wang Sulong begins his Age of Romance world tour Hong Kong stop with the first of three shows at the new stadium, featuring a large-scale stage production.

zh.headline: 汪蘇瀧今晚啟德體育場展開三場演唱會
zh.dek: 內地歌手汪蘇瀧「明日世界」世界巡迴演唱會香港站今晚起一連三晚於啟德體育場舉行，舞台製作包括巨型機械人及大型升降螢幕。

en.headline: CNBC to close Hong Kong office and drop several shows
en.dek: The business channel is shutting its Hong Kong operations as part of a programming overhaul, with coverage of the city and region to continue from other Asian bureaux.

zh.headline: CNBC關閉香港辦事處 停播多個直播節目
zh.dek: 財經頻道確認關閉香港辦公室並調整節目，香港及地區報道將繼續由其他亞洲分社負責。

en.headline: Moonshot AI files confidentially for Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The Beijing developer of the Kimi large language model has submitted a confidential listing application and is said to be targeting about US$3 billion in proceeds.

zh.headline: 月之暗面Moonshot秘密遞表申請香港上市
zh.dek: 開發Kimi大語言模型的北京初創據報已向港交所提交保密申請，目標集資約30億美元。

en.headline: Po Leung Kuk scraps student eco-bag contest after outcry
en.dek: The charity cancelled its “From Martial Love to Love” design competition for primary pupils after public criticism that the theme risked normalising domestic violence.

zh.headline: 保良局取消「從武愛到有愛」環保袋比賽
zh.dek: 活動宣傳以「七大家暴武器」為題引發網民批評美化家暴，保良局周四宣布取消比賽並刪除相關帖文。

en.headline: All tropical cyclone signals cancelled as Saudel weakens
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled every tropical cyclone warning signal at 12.10am after Tropical Depression Saudel weakened into a low-pressure area over inland Guangdong.

zh.headline: 沙德爾減弱為低壓區 所有熱帶氣旋警告信號取消
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨12時10分取消所有熱帶氣旋警告信號，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾已在廣東內陸減弱為低壓區。

en.headline: Century-old Chun On Pawn Shop becomes community pop-up
en.dek: The former pawn shop at 91 Wan Chai Road now hosts exhibitions, a café and free community programmes until mid-December under Project House @ Chun On Pawn.

zh.headline: 百年振安大押變社區共享空間 開放至12月
zh.dek: 灣仔道91號前振安大押現以「壹當」名義營運展覽、咖啡及免費社區活動，開放至12月19日。

en.headline: Over 75% of Wang Chi House owners sign sale agreements
en.dek: The Housing Bureau said 188 households, or about 75.8 per cent of the undamaged block at Wang Fuk Court, had signed Agreements for Sale and Purchase as of Wednesday.

zh.headline: 宏志閣逾七成五業主簽買賣協議 政府繼續收購
zh.dek: 房屋局表示，截至周三共188戶、約75.8%宏志閣業主已簽署《買賣協議》，政府確認繼續推進該座業權收購。

en.headline: Saudel weakens over Guangdong inland; Signal No. 1 stays
en.dek: At 8pm Tropical Depression Saudel was about 280 km northeast of Hong Kong and is forecast to move west-southwest across eastern Guangdong while continuing to weaken.

zh.headline: 沙德爾於廣東內陸減弱 一號戒備信號維持
zh.dek: 下午8時熱帶低氣壓沙德爾位於本港東北約280公里，預料向西南偏西橫過廣東東部內陸並繼續減弱。

en.headline: Court dismisses Zen and four others’ appeal over 612 fund
en.dek: The Court of Appeal rejected challenges by Cardinal Joseph Zen and four co-trustees against their 2022 convictions for failing to register the 612 Humanitarian Relief Fund.

zh.headline: 陳日君等五人612基金案上訴遭駁回
zh.dek: 高等法院上訴庭周四駁回樞機主教陳日君及另外四名信託人就2022年未有登記612人道支援基金定罪的上訴。

en.headline: Over 70,000 subdivided units registered in first six months
en.dek: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said applications as of 31 August covered more than 60 per cent of Hong Kong’s estimated 110,000 subdivided units.

zh.headline: 簡樸房首半年收逾7萬個分間單位登記申請
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至8月31日共收到涉及逾7萬個分間單位、約2萬個住宅單位的登記申請，佔全港估計11萬個分間單位逾六成。

en.headline: National Day fireworks set for Victoria Harbour on 1 October
en.dek: A 23-minute display launching 31,888 shells will mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China under the theme Eternal Radiance.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演10月1日維港上演
zh.dek: 約23分鐘匯演將燃放31,888枚煙花，主題「永明煙花 綻放中華」，慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年。

en.headline: Saudel moves inland over eastern Guangdong; Signal No. 1 remains
en.dek: At 1pm Tropical Storm Saudel was about 330 km northeast of Hong Kong and is forecast to move west across inland areas while weakening gradually.

zh.headline: 沙德爾移入廣東東部內陸 一號戒備信號維持
zh.dek: 下午1時熱帶風暴沙德爾位於本港東北約330公里，預料向西橫過廣東東部內陸並逐漸減弱。

en.headline: Italy-Hong Kong menswear show opens today at Fashion Walk
en.dek: Future Threads gathers ten emerging designers from Hong Kong and Italy at a free Causeway Bay exhibition running through 13 September.

zh.headline: 意港男裝展今起銅鑼灣Fashion Walk免費開放
zh.dek: 香港設計中心聯同意大利國家時裝商會舉辦的「共織新意」今日至9月13日在銅鑼灣展出十個新銳男裝品牌。

en.headline: Hong Kong PMI slips to 49.5 in August after three-month rise
en.dek: The S&P Global Hong Kong SAR PMI fell below the 50 mark, pointing to a renewed contraction in private-sector conditions after July's reading of 51.0.

zh.headline: 8月香港PMI回落至49.5 連升三個月後再收縮
zh.dek: 標普全球香港特區採購經理指數由7月的51.0跌至49.5，顯示私營部門營商環境在連續三個月擴張後再度轉差。

en.headline: Lee attends City Hall ceremony marking victory over Japan
en.dek: The official commemoration of the 81st anniversary of victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression was held at 8am at the Hong Kong City Hall Memorial Garden.

zh.headline: 抗戰勝利81周年 李家超出席大會堂紀念儀式
zh.dek: 特區政府今早8時在香港大會堂紀念花園舉行官方儀式，紀念中國人民抗日戰爭暨世界反法西斯戰爭勝利81周年。
